title: Dead Orbit
brief: Seal hull breaches, conserve oxygen and restore an uplink while infected crew hunt through a failing station.
players: 1–4 LAN cooperative players; local solo campaign

chapters.title: Cold Dock
chapters.story: Nia wakes to a station full of open airlocks and a voice asking her to preserve the crew manifest.

chapters.title: The Quiet Ring
chapters.story: The quiet ring still has breathable air, but every repair brings the infected closer.

chapters.title: Last Transmission
chapters.story: The escape pod can carry the survivors only after the uplink tells home where to look.

status: development; build, gameplay, physical controller, multi-machine LAN and Steam release acceptance tracked separately
inspiration: Original characters, names, story and code; genre references are design inspiration only.
